title: 2023 Panini Select Aaron Donald Premier Level Die Cut Silver Prizm #113 Rams RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2023 Panini Select Premier Level Silver Die Cut trading card featuring Aaron Donald of the Los Angeles Rams. The card is part of the 2023 Panini Select set and has a card number of 113. It also has a parallel/variety of Silver Prizm.

The card is perfect for National Football League (NFL) fans and collectors alike. It is an unautographed card with features that include die cut and parallel/variety. This card is a great addition to any football trading card collection and is sure to impress.
